publications.title: Sunday Odds
publications.premise: A fiction series about money. Each Sunday, in her mother's kitchen in Fairfax, Virginia, Anika brings a question about her first real paycheck, and Revathi, who has worked in markets for twenty-six years, answers in odds instead of certainties.
publications.intro: Every Sunday, Anika drives to her mother's kitchen with a question she can't get a straight answer to online. Revathi sketches the numbers on a napkin, disagrees with her, and ends with one Monday Move. Money, here, is a set of odds, not a set of rules.
publications.read_note: New chapters on Sundays. Best read in order.
publications.disclaimer: Sunday Odds is a fiction series about money. Revathi and Anika are fictional, and the figures are illustrative. This is education, not personalized financial, tax or legal advice.
